name: Incident simulation
tool_policy: This is a tabletop exercise. No infrastructure actions run. Reveal only supplied observations.

stages.title: Alert
stages.guidance: State the incident and let the candidate take the lead.

stages.title: Triage
stages.guidance: Reveal requested observations and probe safe prioritization.

stages.title: Mitigation and verification
stages.guidance: Ask how they will mitigate, verify recovery and communicate.

stages.title: Handoff
stages.guidance: Request a short handoff and conclude.
